chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“Whoever is apprehended in the month of Ramadan after having broken the fast, and is brought before the Imam, is killed on the third occasion.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the legitimate religious and judicial authority
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the prescribed time of sawm (fasting)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone repeatedly caught breaking the fast in Ramadan and brought before the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a person caught publicly breaking the fast in the month of Ramadan and then brought before the Imam. It indicates a severe punitive escalation upon repeated offense, placing the matter within the sphere of judicial and religious authority.
